mode: Read-only production-source review; no test or SDK execution
findings: Process LRU stores only source URL, per-entry mutex and checked String map. Current environment/cache/check closure lives in invocation coroutine context and is removed/restored at scope exit.
Explicit open creates the map; explore only peeks. Eviction or an unopened scope does not silently restore/create an InfoMap. Explicit savePending persists only the currently granted source.

Original live Java Map/view ABI is preserved with checked backing. Erased non-String writes fail before old source/task objects can be retained. Escaping scoped bridge/type failures are translated before ordinary login/UI error recovery; JavaScript may catch them.
Native scope is identity of existing Host/source/revision, and checks original grant, deadline and cancellation. The resulting routing string grants no independent persistent authority.

Existing non-explore AnalyzeUrl calls still use the default null InfoMap, while explore passes the same map used by source evaluation. Text/public content saving restrictions and default App route are unchanged.
Swift typed methods use the existing original execute/session/task boundary. Their definitions and grammar are not compilation, JNI or App behavior proof.
limits: This is an additional static source review. Actual JVM/JAR result acceptance requires the retained XML/log/source-continuity and ordinary JAR evidence audit.
Android UI rendering/navigation, JavaUI buttons, all-source onPause saving, complete original string/object-map parity, native/JNI execution and default App route remain unfinished.
